I was suspended from work today.
Who suspended you? Me?
Viktoria Sergeyevna told me to sit here.
Since when do you listen to her?
In this kitchen, only I am the boss!
She promised to fire me, chef.
Only I can fire cooks!
Now march to the kitchen!
A pile of orders is waiting for you there.
Thank you, chef, I am running!
Wait, where are you carrying that pan?
